raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Deputy Manager - Data & Projects | National Stock Exchange of India (NSE India) Mumbai, India | Apr 2024 - Present

Product Solution Design: Defined features and authored BRDs for projects such as NSE WhatsApp Chatbot, Compliance Calendar etc.; translating stakeholder requirements into scoped specifications for engineering delivery

Process Improvement & Automation: Conducted stakeholder workshops to identify manual processes, documented requirements, designed and implemented enterprise-wide PowerApps solutions that standardized workflows across five regional offices, reducing manual effort by 60% while improving data accuracy by 76%.

Executive Decision Support: Partnered with senior business stakeholders to gather reporting requirements, define KPIs and develop Power BI dashboards enabling executive decision-making and business performance monitoring. Built revenue simulation models and conducted regression analysis to statistically present the outcome of product positioning strategies

Product Performance Review: Monitored product performance against business KPIs, conducted post-implementation benefit realization review, tracked adoption, identified enhancement areas and built auto-updating reports for daily reporting
Business Analyst – WAM Platform Transformation | EbixCash Financial Technologies (SEA Region) Mumbai, India (Office) - Indonesia & Philippines (Onsite) | Mar 2021 – Mar 2024

Business Analysis & Platform Transformation: Conducted requirement elicitation workshops with private banking stakeholders, documented business rules, performed process discovery, prepared BRDs, FSDs, user stories and solution documents while supporting SIT, UAT, data migration and production implementation across wealth management platforms. Analyzed Equity and Capital Markets trading workflows, including order management, trade processing, transaction flows and associated operational requirements.

Functional Solution Design: Documented BRDs, SDDs, FSDs, user stories, process flows, business rules and functional specifications covering the end-to-end trade lifecycle, KYC, fund accounting, corporate actions, regulatory reporting and API integrations Managed end-to-end project delivery across requirements gathering, functional analysis, solution design, SIT, UAT, data migration, production implementation and go-live support. Partnered closely with Business Stakeholders, Product Owners, Operations, Technology and QA teams to understand business needs, clarify requirements and deliver functional solutions.
•
Technical Interface & Delivery: Reviewed TSDs, test scripts and managed cross-functional teams. Executed SQL queries to ensure data accuracy. Bridged business needs and engineering team by translating financial concepts into clear functional specifications accelerating project delivery timelines by 23%
•
Stakeholder Management: Facilitated stakeholder workshops, clarified functional requirements, managed change requests, coordinated defect triage, supported SIT/UAT sign-off and communicated delivery progress across business, operations and technology teams in the steering committee meetings

Project Governance: Maintained project documentation including process flows, decision logs, requirement traceability, UAT artefacts and release documentation to support successful project delivery
On-Site Delivery: Led UAT, data migration, pre-sales product demos and supported go-live operations on-site in Jakarta and Manila, securing seamless user adoption
University of Mumbai | 2019–2021 (Full-time)
Bachelor of Commerce (Accounting & Finance)
University of Mumbai | 2016–2019 (Full-time)
Former state-level badminton athlete
